# couchbase-capella-aidp_workflow_run (Resource)

Starts and tracks an AI Data Plane workflow run. Destroy stops an in-progress run for the workflow. There is no update API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "couchbase-capella-aidp_workflow_run" "example" {
  organization_id = var.organization_id
  project_id      = var.project_id
  cluster_id      = var.cluster_id
  workflow_id     = couchbase-capella-aidp_workflow.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String)
- `organization_id` (String)
- `project_id` (String)
- `workflow_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Workflow run identifier.
- `status` (String)
